groups.title: AI Infrastructure Capital Investment

groups.title: NVIDIA FY2027 Financial Performance
groups.scope: NVIDIA FY2027 revenue across products and segments, gross margin, operating expense growth, and tax rates.

groups.title: AI Infrastructure Financing

groups.title: Data-Center Power and Facility Capacity

groups.title: Gaming Software and Cloud Gaming Offerings

groups.title: DGX Spark Product and Software Ecosystem

groups.title: TSMC Advanced-Packaging Investment
